verdict.rationale: Asana's own materials say teams can turn their expertise into custom AI Teammates, configured with an identity, scoped permissions, data access, approved actions and spend limits from a governance console, plus shared memory that learns from completed work. An API endpoint also lists the AI Teammates configured in a workspace, which corroborates that user-configured agents exist in the product. missing for 10: step-by-step documentation of how a user actually builds and configures a custom agent (instructions, triggers, tools), and any independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing copy.
